verdict.rationale: A probe confirms developer.nvidia.com serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) describing the broader NVIDIA developer portal, which an agent could be pointed at; however, page-level agent-friendly markdown docs (e.g., cuda-toolkit.md) return 404, and there is no evidence of an official, product-specific llms.txt or agent-doc set for the RTX 5070 Ti itself. Missing for 10: RTX 5070 Ti-specific agent-oriented docs, working .md endpoints, and any independent confirmation that agents can actually consume this llms.txt for GPU-specific tasks.
